systems.system: more than twenty fragmented health data systems (unnamed)

note: Vendor press release of 15 May 2024: the NIA Platform is an integration and analytics layer over existing systems, so it is logged as exchange and gives no HMIS or EMR fact. It states that data entry is manual and error-prone and that over twenty health data systems are in use, without naming any or saying at which tier data is keyed.
